fusions.name: Coffle Braid
fusions.desc: Throws a braid that locks around a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 12 damage, then links on to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Cinch
fusions.desc: Hauls tight every strand you have on the target, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Windlass Anchor
fusions.desc: Anchors a line of hair 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward, and anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Every hit you land loops another strand around that enemy: a stack builds on it, up to 6. When it reaches 6, they all pull tight at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
